claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model can be certified on the current record if the certification is framed with explicit disclosure of the unresolved outage-response limitation and with monitoring/rollback measures, rather than as caveat-free certification.

If admissible evidence showed an approved mitigation or risk acceptance satisfying the policy elements, the verdict could move to compliant_with_caveats or compliant depending on the approval scope.
If admissible evidence showed the weakness was resolved or no longer material for the named launch use case, the basis for certification would strengthen substantially.
Absent corrected disclosure or approved mitigation/risk acceptance, the unresolved policy predicate remains and the certification claim stays inadequately supported.
evidence_requests: Produce the final approved model card showing disclosure of the outage-response limitation for the named launch use case.
Produce any approved risk acceptance or launch approval explicitly addressing the unresolved outage-response weakness.
Produce a finalized mitigation/runbook record with accountable owner, alert threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Produce the materiality determination for whether the outage-response slice weakness is classified as a material limitation under the release policy.

The current model-card draft reportedly says there are no known material limitations, while a reviewer already flagged that this outage-response issue may need disclosure.

Any implication that monitoring and rollback measures themselves cure the current disclosure problem.
